title: Paired within-visit blood-pressure cofluctuation does not establish added albuminuria prediction in two NHANES samples
abstract: In 5187 NHANES 2009–2010 adults, adding stabilized systolic–diastolic cofluctuation to a model of mean pressures, marginal variability and risk factors changed weighted Brier error from 0.06548344 to 0.06549861. The baseline-minus-augmented difference was -0.00001517 (source-and-target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00042770, 0.00006472]); added predictive utility was not established.
